records.observation:
Entire 1079-line javap displayed in consecutive slices 1–280,281–555,556–830,831–1079. ScrollableObject subclass implements SearchableView/SummarizableView. Constructor stores ModelTime/trunk/YaxisMaps/Y tree/Y range/column names/methods references; unguarded root/depth lookup, creates NestingStacks/DrawnBoxSet. Initial target depth = short(rootDepth-Parameters.INIT_SLOG2_LEVEL_READ+1) then negative clamped0 (short wrap precedes clamp); grows trunk over COPY of full root bounds, sets views-per-update6. Connected-composite false unless nonempty methods, then only methods[0].isConnectCompositeState, no null element guard or later refresh. Constructs shared SearchTreeTrunk with flag; rootFrame/event/listener null. addChangeListener REPLACES one listener and creates event, no multicast/removal; fire checks event not listener, so add(null) later fails. Minimum(0,0), maximum(32767,32767), component height max(treeRows*rowHeight, Yrange.max-min+1), unchecked int arithmetic.
Off-image initialize optionally dates profiling, lazily windowForComponent cast Frame, copies image-time bounds first call, recursively applies Wait cursor, snapshots rows/rowHeight. updateTimeWindow(oldImageBounds,newBounds)==1 drives NestingStacks.initialize flag. Grabs line→row map; if null, YaxisMaps.update false reports dialog but CONTINUES and grabs map again without asserting nonnull. Initializes drawn boxes. Finalize finishes boxes, clears map cache, finishes nesting, copies new bounds into cached object, fires listener BEFORE restoring Normal cursor, then profile timing. No try/finally or recovery within these methods; listener/initialization failure can leave wait cursor, and profiling state toggles can expose null date values.
Drawing null image is no-op; else obtains Graphics2D, speed hint, fills current configured background, makes CoordPixelImage(rowHeight,bounds), antialias off; cyan horizontal lines for rows NOT expanded. Debug/Profile gray left edge. Reset nesting/boxes; increasing-start all nestable pass only visible categories setsStateRowAndNesting. Paint increasing-start real nestables first, then lowest-floor nestable shadows; switch antialias to Parameters.ARROW_ANTIALIASING and paint increasing-start all nestless last. Each paint pass filters category.isVisible only, counts actual draw-return and numPrimitives for optional profile. Selected Y rows/search flags NOT filtered here. Graphics.dispose normal tail only, no finally; state nesting/row fields mutated through drawable call. Rendering and picking order align at group level: nestless above shadow above real nestable.
getPropertyAt uses image time bounds/cached rowHeight for pixel transform and clicked time, but supplied timebox for iteration. Fetches line→leaf map BEFORE optional line→row update, does not re-fetch leaf map afterward; no claim update actually replaces it until YaxisMaps read. Tries decreasing-start all nestless, then lowest-floor nestable shadows, then real nestables. Candidate visible and returned hit drawable visible required, no category searchable/containSearchable/selected-row checks. First hit creates InfoDialogForDrawable(cached rootFrame,clicked time,leaf map,labels,time model,hit); no show/close listener here. Thus previously read Shadow selection consumption reachable. Miss delegates super.getTimePropertyAt; actual window close wiring remains caller-side pending, not absent UI claim.
localRectangleForDrawable uses earliest/latest time pixel difference and rowID±nestingFactor/2 pixel difference, no nonnegative/minimum-pixel clamp or arrow endpoint-row bounding. Four search entrypoints delegate same SearchTreeTrunk previous/next(time/no-time), return null or fresh InfoPanelForDrawable with current line→leaf map/labels; do not center view here and no cursor rollback if panel constructor fails. createSummary directly calls shared tree_search.createBufForTimeAveBoxes(bounds), then new StatlineDialog(owner,bounds,current LineIDMap,buffer), no bounds copy, worker/locking or display here. OperationDurationPanel worker therefore calls actual statistics collection plus dialog construction off EDT and shares tree/criteria/map with canvas; actual races depend scheduling. No log close/disposal hook/EDT marshalling in this class. All details static archived-bytecode reading, not runtime validation or external approval.
